new_proved_obligations.statement: For a in {L,R}, the landing vertices of partial P cap partial Q_a are exactly the source depth-n vertices v_{at}; the open contact is the union of maximal common subsegments of the corresponding boundary rays, with no open equipotential overlap. Exact typed boundary-word matching recovers the complete finite contact graph.

For C_w=partial P cap partial D_w and normalized contact Chat_w=h_w(C_w), Chat_{wa}=g_a(Chat_w cap C_a). After finite source subdivision this is a deterministic finite-state recursion on root boundary subcomplexes for each fixed block.
Incomparable binary cylinders are disjoint; if v=ut then partial D_u cap partial D_v=phi_u(C_t). Hence the two one-step source contacts determine every pairwise contact at arbitrary depth.

For every prefix w of length k<=n, the landing vertices of open contacts partial P cap partial D_w are exactly {v_{wt}: |t|=n-k}, and h_w(v_{wt})=v_t. Incident boundary flags and cyclic order follow the same shift.

For every depth-n word s, the normalized root contact is the same complete two-ray alpha port. The L branch fixes this state, the R branch sends it to the empty contact, and the empty state is absorbing. Thus beyond source depth n the contact automaton has exactly two states.

After source subdivision, every endpoint is retained as a vertex/incident-edge/side/orientation flag; each univalent branch induces a partial cyclic-order-preserving flag map and the maps compose exactly along words.

On the source pseudo-puzzle ideal boundary, a common finite overlay gives atomwise degree-one branch maps. Each root atom has at most one lift per branch, hence at most two lifts. Pullback defines a continuous one-to-many map into the compatible minimum-energy trace tuple space, retaining endpoint sides and cyclic order without an omitted Euclidean welding.
new_proved_obligations.source_hypothesis: Kahn--Lyubich pseudo-puzzle naturality and continuous boundary extension

new_proved_obligations.statement: Direct pseudo-trace pullback under the word map h_w equals chronological composition of the one-step branch restriction relations, with canonical reassociation of compatible tuple spaces; flags and cyclic order compose identically.
The identity h_{wa}=g_a composed with h_w makes contact, flag, compatible trace and finite Dirichlet-response diagrams commute exactly in the co-moving normalized overlay.

A carrier enlargement K_0 subset S subset S+ subset P minus (Q_L union Q_R) changes no puzzle boundary, contact, endpoint, flag or trace-atlas datum. Its pullbacks commute with every shift and parent map; only the internal carrier/cap response changes.

For a finite collision-free refinement whose endpoints are source endpoints or exact branch pullbacks, atom and endpoint-forgetful squares commute, trace subdivision commutes with branch restriction, and minimization over the new internal subdivision traces reconstructs the old response.

For every fixed finite source overlay, the full normalized binary depth-r pseudo-puzzle Dirichlet response satisfies the exact recursion Q_{r+1}=B star (Q_r^(L) direct-sum Q_r^(R)). The recursively shared response circuit has O(r) description size, commutes with normalized-overlay maps, safe-gap carrier enlargement, and certified finite overlay refinement, although its expanded leaf trace space may still have 2^r ports.

For d-state coefficient transitions M_L,M_R and w-dimensional branch transports R_L,R_R, every depth-r weighted binary leaf observable is exactly computed in dimension dw by (u^T tensor I_w)(M_L tensor R_L + M_R tensor R_R)^r(v tensor x). Activation for KKL Value remains conditional on a source proof that all required coefficients and feature transports obey one universal finite-state linear law.

For one source-licensed finite primitive terminal Hubbard tree with edge set E, KKL Value at pullback level m is exactly the contraction of aa^T with a positive semidefinite second-moment state indexed by E x E. The state dimension is at most |E|^2(|E|^2+1)/2. Every incidence-preserving univalent binary branch acts by M -> P_a M P_a^T, and the joint binary pullback acts by the completely positive map M -> P_L M P_L^T + P_R M P_R^T. Universal dimension and the virtual typed factor remain open.
